subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord keep a channel-local session-conflict fallback after the shared self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should recovery be consolidated in shared session initialization?
rationale: Both layers can address the same conflict, but retaining both changes timing and state ownership; source inspection cannot establish maintainer intent for the permanent recovery boundary.

options.title: Consolidate on shared recovery
options.body: Treat the proof-positive shared self-heal as the canonical fix and close or narrow this PR once that path is accepted.

options.title: Keep a Discord fallback
options.body: Retain channel-local recovery only after repairing the prepared-dispatch and replay-settlement defects and proving why shared recovery is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on shared recovery
recommendation.body: Treat the proof-positive shared self-heal as the canonical fix and close or narrow this PR once that path is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current shared assembled/prepared turn boundary that determines whether a channel-local retry can avoid repeated preparation.
